# headroom

> Declutter and speed up an Android car head unit over ADB. No root, nothing
> uninstalled, every step reversible.

headroom runs from a laptop and talks to an Android head unit over ADB. It
measures the unit first, disables the telemetry, ads, promo and preloaded apps
the owner does not use, applies reversible speed settings, optionally replaces
the home screen, and asks a person at the car to confirm the reverse camera,
steering-wheel buttons, radio, Bluetooth calls, navigation, sleep and wake after
every batch. It never roots, flashes, factory-resets, opens factory menus,
uninstalls, or reads personal data.

## Start here

- `AGENTS.md` — the contract: interview, hard rules, order of operations,
  recovery. Read this first.
- `README.md` — what changes, what it will not do, and how to run it.
- `PROMPT.md` — a paste-ready block for a coding assistant.
- `CLAUDE.md` — the four rules that matter most, for Claude Code.
- `llms.txt` — this index.

## Docs

- `docs/CONNECTING.md` — hotspot, ADB methods, pairing, pyadb, reconnecting.
- `docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md` — the levers, the guard table, what is not used and why.
- `docs/CAR-SAFETY.md` — when and where to run, the car checks, distraction.
- `docs/ADDING-A-UNIT.md` — from a discovery report to a reviewed profile.
- `docs/BENCHMARKING.md` — the measurement rules.
- `docs/GOTCHAS.md` — inherited surprises and field notes.
- `docs/WHY-NOT-ROOT.md` — why the shell user is enough.
- `docs/FAQ.md` — warranty, updates, CarPlay, Private DNS, older units.

## Data

- `data/common/` — shared never-disable lists, app names, car checks, patterns.
- `data/profiles/` — per-unit package tiers and matches.
- `catalog/devices/` — identifier-free entries for units that were tested.

## Tests

No head unit is needed:

```sh
python3 -m venv tools/venv
tools/venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
tools/venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```
